title: Greetings
label: ch:greetings
canDo: I can greet someone, say yes, no and thank you, agree with sari, hold a short exchange out loud, and copy my first Tamil shape with a visible model.

payoff.summary: Hold the whole exchange out loud, say back where vaṇakkam and naṉṟi come from and how Tamil answers yes, then copy வ once beside the visible model and compare only that shape.
payoff.note: TA-C01-practice assesses all twelve atoms the chapter introduces: the five spoken words and the greeting's sound and two-way use, a say-it-back of the vaṇakkam and naṉṟi origins and family register, emphatic āmām and the echoed-verb yes, the farewell recap it introduces itself, and one supported copy of வ with the model visible.
